sources.name: Olist Brazilian E-Commerce
sources.note: Public marketplace data 2016-2018; merchant dimensions are computed from it. Sellers are anonymised.

sources.name: CFPB Consumer Complaints
sources.note: Daily incremental feed; used only as an external dispute/resolution benchmark, not joined to merchants.

sources.name: Stripe-shaped agent payment events
sources.note: Generated to spec/data-contract.md; payment_risk fields are synthetic.

dimensions.delivery: Share of delivered orders arriving on or before the promised date.
dimensions.price: Item price vs category median (cheaper = higher).
dimensions.contract: Severity of broken delivery promises (mean days late).
dimensions.latency: Days from payment approval to carrier handoff.
dimensions.dispute: Share of orders cancelled/unavailable or rated <=2 stars (inverted).
dimensions.consistency: Spread of delivery delay (lower variance = higher).
dimensions.comms: PROXY: share of orders handed to carrier before the seller's own ship-by date.
dimensions.resolution: PROXY: share of late orders that still ended with a >=4 star review.

meta.scoring: Each dimension in [0,1], Bayesian-smoothed toward marketplace mean (m=10); mdt_score = equal-weight mean.
